tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Jacksonville, Florida

about: Geddes Anderson is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2011 - 2026. He works at Murphy & Anderson, P.A., located in Jacksonville, Florida, and provides legal services for issues involving Business Litigation, Civil Litigation: Defense and Employment Litigation: Defense to the surrounding community.
Geddes Anderson completed legal studies at University of Florida Levin College of Law and graduated with the class of 1997. Geddes Anderson passed the bar in 1998.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
